Under the frozen preview1 interface, Y must read and write all 512 MiB through fd_read and fd_write. wasip1 is single-threaded, so each operator gets one core. At about 8 GB/s, each takes at least 67.1 ms. The floor is max(134.2/4, 67.1) = 67.1 ms. ln(67.1/4.81) = 2.64, well above b = 0.236. Even a 2x faster copy would remain far outside the band."}
